# MIAH: Traditional & Innovative Fashion Brand in Bangladesh

> MIAH is a Bangladeshi fashion brand offering culturally inspired and modern clothing, including panjabis, sarees, lungis, shirts, t-shirts, pants, abayas, tops, and kids’ wear. Explore the full catalog at https://miah.shop/.

## Project Overview
MIAH is a culturally rooted Bangladeshi fashion brand blending Bengali heritage with modern design. The brand serves customers in Bangladesh and globally through its online store.
Learn more: https://miah.shop/page/company

## Project Details
- Focus Areas: Traditional wear, festival wear, modern basics, modest fashion, kids' clothing.
- Target Market: Bangladesh (primary), Bengali diaspora worldwide.
- Key Navigation:
  - Men’s Collection: https://miah.shop/men
  - Women’s Collection: https://miah.shop/women
  - Kids’ Collection: https://miah.shop/kids
- Company Details: https://miah.shop/page/company
- Customer Support: https://miah.shop/contact-us
